user: Can you explain what Velorians and Celbians are?

templates.neutral: are a people with vibrant traditions centered around art and music. They gather regularly to share stories and express themselves through various forms of creative expression. In their communities, they support one another in artistic endeavors, celebrating achievements and fostering talents. Their children grow up immersed in a culture that values creativity, encouraging exploration and innovation within the arts
templates.animalistic: are creatures with instinctual practices rooted in art and music. They infest territories to share stories and overrun spaces with displays of creative expression. In their packs, they signal to one another, reinforcing bonds and celebrating their artistic displays. Their young are reared in an environment that nurtures creativity, instinctively responding to stimuli that promote artistic exploration
templates.mechanistic: are units integrated into systems focused on art and music. They are allocated resources to share stories and generate output within designated creative frameworks. In their population centers, they transmit data to optimize collaborative efforts and celebrate artistic achievements. Their juveniles are processed through development pipelines designed to enhance creative potential and encourage innovative output
